info.title: Care Quality Commission
info.description: Every registered care location in England — care homes, GP practices, hospitals — with its official inspection rating. Requires a FREE subscription key (register at api-portal.service.cqc.org.uk, set CQC_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY); until the key is present this integration stays inert, by design.

get.summary: Registered care locations for a postcode area, with overall ratings
get.description: `locations[]` carries `locationName`, `postalCode`, and `currentRatings.overall.rating` ('Outstanding' | 'Good' | 'Requires improvement' | 'Inadequate'). Search by outward code (SE10) for the neighbourhood's providers.

parameters.name: postalCode
parameters.description: Full postcode or outward code, e.g. SE10.
